name: Newport Country Club
architects: William F. Davis (1894-99); A. W. Tillinghast (1921-23 remodel); Ron Forse (restoration from 1995)

dtm.source: 2022 USGS Lidar DEM: RI Statewide (RI_StatewideLidar_2022_D22, QL1; NOAA Data Access Viewer, job J1476269), 1 ft pixels, NAD83(2011) / Rhode Island (EPSG:6568, US ft), NAVD88 US ft; ordered by the developer 2026-10-25 (GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, newport.cc.zip), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py raster

laz.source: 2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9981, job J1476270), flown 29 March 2022 (GPS times), leaf-off; no vegetation classes (trees from class 1, roofs dropped by roof_last_share as at Wannamoisett); NAD83(2011) / Rhode Island (EPSG:6567, m), NAVD88 m; GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, ri2022_statewide_J1476270.zip, clipped to the world with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2022 USGS RI statewide lidar, leaf-off

ortho.source: USDA NAIP via the USGS National Map ImageServer, exported by the developer 2026-10-25 as two JPEGs at 0.5 m in EPSG:32619 (release assorted-lidar-data: 123.jpg south, 1212.jpg north), placed by their request boxes and mosaicked by pipeline/intake.py ortho; flight year not stated

world.note: OSM course boundary (relation 13922079) bbox 898 x 1,790 m in UTM 19N + scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,280 m east-west (191 m each side), 2,048 m north-south (the 2,048 m limit: 129 m south and north)

scorecard_source: GolfPass (golfpass.com/courses/12085-newport-country-club/scorecard-and-layout), read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat: seven sets per hole, par 72, men's and women's stroke index (column handicap_w), rows add up (its tee table's lengths differ slightly). Wikipedia's per-hole table differs; unverified, no club card online. Played from the tips, Black 7,109 yd (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"); rating GolfPass tee table, Black 75.5/135 (the table prints 7,083 yd and par 70; the per-hole card adds to 7,109 at par 72, used here). The other sets are in scorecard.csv but not built.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide), via NOAA Digital Coast
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-25: standing defaults (every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar). Played from the tips: Black (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"). Wind 3-14 mph (open coast). Par 72 as on the card (championships play 70). Theme newport: the course's own, from the developer's photos (developer: a new theme for each course).

join_boundary_parts.note: the boundary is mapped as two parts (45.1 and 19.4 ha) on either side of Harrison Avenue, 12 m apart; holes 2-8 are west of the road. Joined so both are in play; the road between them stays out of bounds (brief: 'if OSM's boundary leaves Harrison Avenue out, the road is OB between the two parts')

red_water_note: the sea (proposed/sea.geojson, from OSM's coastline beyond Ocean Drive): a red penalty area (standing default)
rough_band_note: a mown band of rough along the fairways, then the wispy native fescue the photos show (brief: as at Highland Links)

green_tilt.note: the 11th's small green (258 m2): tilt capped at 2 % and no random undulations, so the game finds three pin positions on it under 3 % (pins.test.ts; COURSE_LESSONS 4)
